rules.description: Employee must have 2 or more years of continuous employment
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have at least 2 years of continuous employment to qualify for statutory redundancy pay

rules.description: Redundancy must be compulsory, not voluntary
rules.reason_if_failed: Statutory redundancy pay only applies to compulsory redundancies

rules.description: Must be an employee (not self-employed or contractor)
rules.reason_if_failed: Only employees are entitled to statutory redundancy pay. Self-employed and contractors do not qualify

rules.description: Age must be verifiable for calculation purposes
rules.reason_if_failed: Date of birth is required to calculate your statutory redundancy entitlement

rules.description: Weekly pay must be provided (subject to £643 cap)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your average weekly pay is needed to calculate the redundancy amount

explanation_template: Statutory redundancy pay eligibility: {outcome}. Calculated amount: {amount}

edge_cases.description: Employer cannot pay because they are insolvent
edge_cases.action: Hand off to Insolvency Service redundancy payments service. Contact 0330 331 0020 or redundancypaymentsonline@insolvency.gov.uk

edge_cases.description: Employer refuses to pay statutory redundancy
edge_cases.action: Hand off to Employment Tribunal via Acas. Contact Acas on 0300 123 1100 for early conciliation before tribunal claim

edge_cases.description: Dispute over length of continuous employment
edge_cases.action: Contact Acas for advice and potential mediation. May require Employment Tribunal if unresolved

edge_cases.description: Complex situation (multiple employers, breaks in service, part-time hours)
edge_cases.action: Hand off to Acas advisory service for detailed calculation guidance
